content.text: We give you two routes to mobile play \- a native application and a browser-based option.

The MrBeast app delivers full platform access in a native format built for smartphones and tablets. Download it directly from our website \- it runs on both iOS and Android. Because it operates natively on your device, load times are faster and the interface feels tighter than a standard browser session. Every feature available on desktop \- games, banking, account settings, and the daily Fortune Wheel \- is fully functional inside the app.
